data.name: Claude
data.long_meaning: Claude is derived from the Latin word claudus, meaning 'lame' or 'disabled'. In Christian tradition, it is believed that the name was given to those who had been cured of physical disabilities or who had overcome great challenges in their lives. The name has also been associated with saints such as St. Claude of Besançon, who is said to have miraculously healed the blind, and St. Claude of Paray-le-Monial, who is known for his devotion to the Blessed Virgin Mary.
